You’ll lead the deployment and integration of autonomous vulnerability management and security technologies across complex enterprise, government, and defense infrastructures. The role combines hands-on coding with systems engineering, security operations, and direct engagement with technical and senior customer stakeholders. You’ll work with challenging architectures, including air-gapped networks, IT/OT environments, VPCs, Linux systems, and containerized platforms. Your expertise will directly contribute to identifying vulnerabilities, validating remediation, hardening systems, and improving automated security capabilities. You’ll also act as a critical bridge between customer environments and internal engineering and AI teams, turning real-world challenges into product improvements.
